stem:
Deepak draws rectangle ABCD. Point X moves on side AD and point Y moves on side BC. He wants to track how near or far X and Y are.

Which statement is correct?

options.text: Track only the position of Y; the position of X is not needed.
Nearness can be decided without placing X on AD and Y on BC.
Measure the length of segment XY; that length changes as X and Y move.
X and Y are near when the printed letters look close on the page.

teacher.key_rationale: Nearness of X and Y is the length of segment XY and must be tracked with both positions. Watching only Y substitutes one point for the pair. Dropping the sides AD and BC omits the placement condition. Judging by how close the printed letters look is surface capture.
